scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] NetSuite integration project 6 months overdue despite MuleSoft investment (intensity 9/10, stage: Technology Integration Foundation → Data Migration) ← flagged as binding
2. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] 90+ Salesforce customizations making standard implementations complex (intensity 8/10, stage: Technology Integration Foundation → System Configuration) ← flagged as binding
3. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Sales teams waste 3 days per week on admin due to manual processes (intensity 8/10, stage: Sales Territory Management → Account Visit Execution) ← flagged as binding
4. [DataSignalFriction] Lack of customer intelligence requiring manual information gathering from customer care (intensity 7/10, stage: Sales Territory Management → Customer Intelligence Gathering) ← flagged as binding
5. [GovernanceRiskFriction] Multiple implementation partner failures causing delivery instability (intensity 7/10, stage: Technology Integration Foundation → Implementation Partner Selection) ← flagged as binding
6. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] Distributors becoming order takers rather than proactive sellers (intensity 6/10, stage: Product Distribution Lifecycle → Distributor Engagement)
7. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] Sales team not logging CRM activities due to system inadequacy concerns (intensity 6/10, stage: Sales Territory Management → Opportunity Development)
